# MALDA OSS — LLM doc index

Canonical reading order for tools and agents working on this repository.

## Start

- AGENTS.md — agent/human working map (build, tests, edit locations, hard rules)
- README.md — product overview and IDE roles
- CONTRIBUTING.md — contribution workflow
- docs/start-here.md — learning paths
- docs/architecture.md — pipeline and project map
- docs/roadmap-p0-maturity.md — P0 maturity roadmap (complete; types, workflows, parity, AI, UI)
- docs/roadmap-p0-types-impl.md — P0 types T1–T4 implementation plan (status: implemented)
- docs/roadmap-language-constructs.md — post-Final language constructs plan (schema/sum types, Mode C, budget, WF determinism, grounded values, capability tokens)
- docs/roadmap-trust.md — trust plan (strict compile, transpile smoke, loud gotchas; toolchain 1.0.0 landed)
- docs/roadmap-interpret-debug.md — interpret-mode source-level debug plan (DAP + shared DebugSession; not transpile `#line`)
- docs/roadmap-games.md — browser games kit (JS-only `game.*` / `three.*`; G0–G16 landed)
- docs/games-2d-gap-analysis.md — 2D kit gaps vs Love2D / Pico-8 / Phaser / Godot (evaluation, not a workstream plan)
- docs/debugging-interpret.md — `malda debug-adapter` CLI notes (interpret DAP; VS Code F5 is D3)

## Writing MALDA programs (language pack)

- docs/llm/README.md — how to load the pack, and how to smoke-test interactive/random programs
- docs/llm/malda-syntax.md — compact idioms / do-don't
- docs/llm/malda-gotchas.md — mistakes that run without error
- docs/llm/malda-grammar.md — plain-text BNF
- docs/llm/malda-builtins-min.md — high-frequency builtins and top-level objects
- docs/llm/malda-builtins.tsv — every builtin, grep-able, generated from the engine
- docs/llm/few-shot/ — tiny runnable snippets

## Language reference (deeper)

- ReferenceManual/index.html — HTML reference home
- docs/spec/malda-language-1.0.md — language spec notes
- docs/spec/README.md — spec folder index
- malda-cheat-sheet.html — quick syntax cheat sheet (HTML; prefer docs/llm for agents)

## Tooling topics

- docs/javascript-backend.md — JS/PWA backend
- docs/ui-framework.md — server-driven UI runtime / UIHost
- docs/native-numeric-rollout.md — typed transpile levels
- docs/profiling.md — profiler usage
- MaldaLang.LanguageServer/README.md — LSP capabilities
- vscode-malda/README.md — VS Code extension

## Examples

- Examples/Basics/
- Examples/Prompts/
- Examples/Web/
- Examples/Games/
- Examples/Actors/
- Templates/webapi/
- Templates/fullstack/

## Note

docs/planning/ contains historical design notes. Prefer docs/roadmap-language-constructs.md for the next language-construct work; prefer docs/roadmap-trust.md for publish/trust (strict compile, smoke, gotchas); prefer docs/roadmap-p0-maturity.md for completed P0 / deferred non-language items; prefer AGENTS.md, docs/architecture.md, ReferenceManual/, and the code when behavior disagrees with planning docs.
